name: com.sobot.online.activity.SobotOnlineExitActivity
description: When chooses to leave or sign in again from the agent service in Sobot Online, Sobot's Online SDK for support agents opens this page. It disconnects the current service session and either exits the workspace or starts sign-in again.
disableEffect: The agent will not be able to exit or restart their Sobot Online session through this prompt.
